purpose: Separate body and limb artwork for jointed walk/run animation. Original full-body sprites remain for other poses.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: separated sprite parts for a 2D skeletal animation rig. Use input solely as the character's identity and style reference. Preserve red stud cap, dark hair, warm brown skin, turquoise jacket, yellow shirt, navy shorts, cream sneakers with coral soles; legs have bare brown knees and calves. This is NOT a grid of whole-character poses. Make a clean 3-column by2-row atlas of SEPARATE BODY PARTS, exactly6 cells with transparent alpha background. Canvas1536x1024, eachcell512x512. Every isolated part is centered in its cell, with32px empty margin. ALL original clean black outlines, flat shading, same palette and proportions. No labels, no grid, no text, no shadows.
Cell top-left: the character's HEAD, NECK, TORSO and HIP/SHORTS as ONE joined upper-body sprite, facing RIGHT at original three-quarter angle. NO ARMS, NO HANDS, NO LEGS, NO SHOES in this cell. The body bottom is the hip/pants edge; limb sockets have smooth rounded hidden attachment ends. For fox the tail stays attached behind this torso.
Cell top-middle: ONE separated whole arm from rounded shoulder to hand/glove, relaxed pointing DOWN, elbow slightly bent forward. Includes jacket sleeve/robot dark forearm/orange forearm as appropriate. Shoulder joint at top-center; hand atbottom. No torso fragments.
Cell top-right: ONE separated UPPER LEG/THIGH only, straight vertical, hip rounded joint at top, knee joint at bottom. Simple short rounded segment with character-correct material/color. NO shoe or foot.
Cell bottom-left: ONE separated LOWER LEG/SHIN only, straight vertical, knee rounded joint at top, ankle atbottom. NO foot or boot attached. Matchesupperleg.
Cell bottom-middle: ONE separated SHOE/BOOT/FOOT PAW only, horizontal, viewed from side at original slight three-quarter view, toe points RIGHT, flatsolebelow, ankle entry atupperleft-third. Compact, no leg protruding.
Cell bottom-right: one SMALL fully assembled neutral standing character, identity/style reference only, same facingright original character.
Make every part much larger than its final assembled proportion within its own cell so details are crisp, but the body keeps exactoriginalproportions. Animation code willscaleandjoinparts. ALL6 parts completely separate with transparent space; exactlyone of eachrequestedpart. This is a paper-doll sprite parts atlas for joints; do not draw extra limbs or disconnected bits. Fullopaquecharactercoloredpixels with genuine transparent exterior.
